description: GTFS Sverige 2 is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Samtrafiken. GTFS data of all the planned public transport in Sweden. Coverage: Samtrafiken. The publisher named on the listing is Samtrafiken. Its keywords include transport, public transport, H4S-18, Tram, Train, Samtrafiken. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.trafiklab.se/api/gtfs-sverige-2/licens). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
